basic_info.description: Welcome to 3124 Clay Streeta sun-drenched, top-floor 3BD/2BA residence on a stunning tree-lined block in Pacific Heights. This beautifully appointed unit features hardwood floors throughout, a spacious living area with sweeping views of Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower, and a private rear deck perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, while all three bedrooms offer comfort and flexibility. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, central A/C, and one-car parking. Just steps to the library, chic shops, and acclaimed restaurants, this is the best of San Francisco living in an unbeatable location.
